content_sections.heading: NPCC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NPCC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NPCC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NPCC Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 1 for Sr. Associate (Office Support)-Finance and 1 for Assistant (Office Support)-Finance.

content_sections.heading: NPCC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Sr. Associate (Office Support)-Finance: CA/ CMA/ MBA(Fin.)/ Post Graduate in relevant discipline from Recognized University/ Institute (Regular Course) Recognized by UGC/ AICTE. Assistant (Office Support)-Finance: B.Com (Regular Course) with typing speed on Computer of 50 W.P.M.

content_sections.heading: NPCC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 40 years for all posts. Age cut-off date: 31 July 2026. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: NPCC Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Sr. Associate (Office Support)-Finance: Rs. 33,750.00 Per Month Assistant (Office Support)-Finance: Rs. 25,000.00 Per Month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NPCC recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for NPCC recruitment is scheduled for 31 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for which NPCC is recruiting?
faq.answer: NPCC is recruiting for two posts: Sr. Associate (Office Support)-Finance and Assistant (Office Support)-Finance.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced by NPCC?
faq.answer: NPCC has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the mentioned posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Sr. Associate (Office Support)-Finance?
faq.answer: For Sr. Associate (Office Support)-Finance, candidates need to have CA/CMA/MBA(Fin.)/Post Graduate in a relevant discipline from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for Assistant (Office Support)-Finance?
faq.answer: The required qualification for Assistant (Office Support)-Finance is a B.Com (Regular Course) with a typing speed of 50 W.P.M. on a computer.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for these NPCC posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 40 years, with the age cut-off date being 31 July 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Sr. Associate (Office Support)-Finance post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Sr. Associate (Office Support)-Finance post is Rs. 33,750.00 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Assistant (Office Support)-Finance post?
faq.answer: The Assistant (Office Support)-Finance post offers a salary of Rs. 25,000.00 per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for NPCC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this NPCC recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for NPCC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for NPCC recruitment involves a Walk-In Interview followed by Document Verification.
